mapper.sql: id, run_id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, execution_status, owner_instance_id, heartbeat_at, lease_until, fencing_token, recovery_strategy, recovered_by_instance_id, recovery_attempts, recovery_lease_until, runtime_resume_token, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_t r SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_interaction_request_t i WHERE i.id = #{interactionId} AND i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND i.user_id = r.user_id AND i.session_id = r.session_id AND ( i.status = 'RESPONDING' OR ( i.status = 'ANSWERED' AND i.interaction_type = 'INTENT_CLARIFICATION' ) ) AND i.continue_run_id = r.id )

UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e SET heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE e.run_id = #{runId} AND e.owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId} AND e.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.id = e.run_id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.session_id = e.session_id AND r.status = 'RUNNING' )

UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e SET heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND (e.run_id, e.owner_instance_id, e.fencing_token) IN
(#{claim.runId}, #{claim.ownerInstanceId}, #{claim.fencingToken})
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.id = e.run_id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.session_id = e.session_id AND r.status = 'RUNNING' )
mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.run_id, e.tenant_id, e.user_id, e.session_id, e.execution_status, e.owner_instance_id, e.heartbeat_at, e.lease_until, e.fencing_token, e.recovery_strategy, e.recovered_by_instance_id, e.recovery_attempts, e.recovery_lease_until, e.runtime_resume_token, e.metadata_json, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e JOIN fin_ex_chat_run_t r ON r.id = e.run_id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.session_id = e.session_id WHERE e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND (e.run_id, e.owner_instance_id, e.fencing_token) IN
(#{claim.runId}, #{claim.ownerInstanceId}, #{claim.fencingToken})
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e SET lease_until = LEAST(e.lease_until, #{leaseUntil}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE e.run_id = #{runId} AND e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r WHERE r.id = e.run_id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.user_id = e.user_id AND r.session_id = e.session_id AND r.status = 'CANCELLING' )

UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t SET execution_status = #{terminalStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND execution_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'WAITING_USER', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t WHERE execution_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t WHERE execution_status = 'RECOVERING' AND recovery_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY recovery_lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t SET execution_status = 'RECOVERING', recovered_by_instance_id = #{recoveredByInstanceId}, recovery_strategy = #{strategy}, recovery_attempts = recovery_attempts + 1, recovery_lease_until = #{recoveryLeaseUntil}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND ( (execution_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (execution_status = 'RECOVERING' AND recovery_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )

UPDATE fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t SET execution_status = 'RUNNING', owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId}, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, recovery_lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND execution_status = 'RECOVERING' AND recovered_by_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND execution_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
